thread:
Maya: Quick design thread: we need per-route quota and telemetry propagation when using service-account scoped keys. Proposal: issue short-lived route-scoped tokens that carry routing hints, enforce quotas at the edge router, and add telemetry tags to traces. TL;DR: move routing decision to edge using token metadata.
Tom: Edge routing based on token metadata sounds reasonable, but how do we prevent token stuffing / permission spike? Do we map token->project->quota in a cache? Cache invalidation concerns.
Ji: Security note: scoped tokens must be signed and include aud/project/id, exp. Prefer HMAC with `kid` rotation. Also please avoid logging raw org/project IDs in plaintext.
Lena: UX ask: console should let users create 'route tokens' with a scope dropdown (read/ingest/embed), selectable routes, and TTL slider. Default TTL = 1h; optionally allow long-lived via service-account exchange flow.
Rob: Operational idea: edge needs fast lookup. Suggest compact token format: prefix header with an 8-byte routing hint + signature. Router verifies signature with cached keyset. For quota checks, use local leaky-bucket counters with async reconciliation to central quota service.
Maya: Example token header (informal): ```token_v1|proj:acme:123|routes:embed,generate|exp:1710000000|sig:xxxx``` Not final syntax, just illustration.
Tom: We also need fallback behavior: if routing metadata missing or verification fails, fallback to org-level default route (not hard reject) to avoid outages during rollout.
Ji: Agreed on controlled fallback but restrict it to read-only endpoints. Rotation: key rotation must be zero-downtime with overlap window; expose a `/.well-known/keyset` endpoint for routers to refresh.
Lena: @Maya what's the proposed rollout plan? Can we ship router-side checks behind a feature flag + telemetry so we can measure rejects/latency before blocking?
Maya: Plan: A/B rollout for 2 weeks. Flag per-tenant opt-in to edge-routing. Collect metrics: `authz_fail_rate`, `routing_mismatch`, `added_latency_ms`. Console will show a new "Authz Routing" dashboard. After 2 weeks, evaluate and move to global opt-in.
Rob: Telemetry: include `token.scope` and `token.source` as tags on spans, but PII rule: hash project IDs when stored in long-term metrics.
Ji: Strong +1 on hashing. Also ensure logs redact full token; only emit `kid` and `token_digest=sha256(token)[:8]` for troubleshooting.
Tom: Router capacity question: for 10k projects cache is trivial, but for 100k+ we need sharding. Router team - can you surface rough memory & cpu numbers for 100k entries?
Rob: Router rough numbers: ~200 bytes per project entry (routing hint + metadata) -> 100k ~= 20MB RAM. Main cost is GC and keyset parsing; will benchmark before rollout.
Lena: From product: console should add a "preview route" button when creating tokens to simulate routing outcome and show expected quota bucket. Helps platform SREs and customers validate tokens.
Maya: Any blockers? If none I'll draft an RFC and a small PR with router prototype + console mockups. Need signoff from @Ji on security header and threat model.
Ji: :thumbsup: I'll review the RFC. One ask: include a concise threat model section (token theft, replay, privilege escalation, key compromise) and mitigation mappings.
